recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17433; nearby rendering/display or CodeableReference topics should remain separate issue decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-17433 asked FHIR core to make clear that ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile can be used for canonical targets as well as Reference targets, enabling forms such as canonical(ValueSet), canonical(StructureDefinition), and canonical(CodeSystem).
initial_application: The request was applied by svn revision 14218, represented by git commit 30f92b7806dc9e99c6553a0607eb4ead2265cef4, which changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from Reference-only targetProfile wording to Reference/canonical wording.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini. The July 2018 committers Zulip thread confirms targetProfile as the mechanism for qualifying canonical target types, and FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-17433 as Persuasive. Related FHIR-17438 concerned display/documentation and FHIR-34462 later broadened eld-17 to CodeableReference without removing canonical support.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml defines ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile as canonical(StructureDefinition|ImplementationGuide), describes it as applying to Reference/canonical targets, and has eld-17 allowing canonical. source/references.html also links canonical(Any) target constraints to ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile.

related_jiras.note: Raised from the same canonical target-type discussion, but concerned face-up rendering and broader documentation rather than the ElementDefinition.targetProfile rule audited here.
Later allowed targetProfile for CodeableReference in eld-17 while retaining the canonical allowance established by FHIR-17433.
